Definition: Derive timestamp, calendar/session, completeness, vintage or provenance-quality facts
Exclusion: Not directional market behaviour, candidate policy or weighted composite score

Definition: Arithmetic, return, ratio, delta bucket, trade-flow or book-operation reduction of market signal values
Exclusion: No fitted distribution, predictive inference, candidate economics or decision policy

Definition: Historical volatility, rank, z-score, historical regression, dependence, dispersion or empirical event-rate statistic
Exclusion: Not forward-looking scenario or fitted risk-neutral/physical probability distribution

Definition: Fitted IV surface, inferred probability, dealer exposure, latent scenario or conditional probabilistic regime
Exclusion: Not a simple observed signal transformation or historical descriptive estimator

Definition: Multifeature weighted/parameterised scalar score reflecting state or suitability with nontrivial aggregation weights
Exclusion: Not an externally decided permissible limit/action or a raw arithmetic proxy

Definition: Construct a validated typed multi-signal state vector without treating it as a scalar arithmetic result
Exclusion: Not a fitted probability model or configured trade decision

Definition: Prospective execution cost, candidate structure exposure, payoff, expected P&L or stress value
Exclusion: Not permissible risk limits, sizing selection, execution command or actual live holdings

Definition: Current portfolio risk Greeks, current P&L, position continuation/modification or liquidation value
Exclusion: Not pre-trade candidate valuation, prescribed hedge/action, or realised fill measurement

Definition: Output is a rule-governed gating, risk budget, size, order-price, exposure selection, hedge or other policy classification
Exclusion: Not merely measuring market facts, economic amounts, or a score used by a separate decision

Definition: Measure completed order fill, completion or realised execution cost
Exclusion: Not forecast cost or a trading order decision

Definition: Attribute realised/marked P&L over an observed path to the defined risk component or residual
Exclusion: Not live aggregate P&L fields, prospective P&L or forecast scoring

Definition: Evaluate locked forecasts, signal value, decision quality, counterfactuals, or model drift on evidence/outcomes
Exclusion: Not current market assessment, prospective strategy utility or order selection

Definition: Schedule the next observation/derived recalculation event
Exclusion: Not a trade execution action or current market feature
